design_description: A bold retro-modern design built on the Legacy template, using oversized sky-blue cross-shaped striping over a deep royal blue base. The geometric layout creates a strong visual identity inspired by classic football kits, while the clean symmetry gives the jersey a structured and timeless feel. White trims on the collar and sleeve cuffs brighten the palette and reinforce the vintage aesthetic. Overall, the design feels iconic and heritage-driven — blending old-school football striping with a sharper contemporary execution.
